title: Local Basin Refinement with Round-3 Seed and Reduced Mutation Amplitude
scientific_hypothesis: The Round 4 score regression (0.7731→0.7611) indicates the optimizer escaped the local optimum basin due to excessive mutation amplitude. Constraining mutations to ±2.5% of the Round 3 optimal thickness vector should recover and potentially exceed the Round 3 peak by fine-tuning within the verified local curvature basin.
design_principle: Use the Round 3 optimal thickness vector [250.6, 306.5, 256.0, 300.9, 269.6, 278.7, 239.9, 252.1, 238.387, 334.157, 200.0, 272.928, 192.949, 242.657, 338.575, 246.850, 246.143, 284.074, 228.257, 247.132, 167.188] nm as seed geometry. Apply gradient-based thickness optimization with mutation bounds limited to ±2.5% of seed values to prevent phase-mismatch excursions while allowing fine-tuning of non-critical layers.
proposed_topology: 21-layer defect-cavity stack: (HfO2/SiO2) alternating mirror layers with central HfO2 defect layer at position 10 (index 10, 0-based). Exact sequence: HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2(defect)|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2 on fused silica substrate, air incident medium.
design_variables: All 21 layer thicknesses with ±2.5% mutation bounds from Round 3 seed
soft_objectives: Improve best_target_score relative to Round 3 peak (0.7731)
manufacturing_considerations: All thicknesses within fabrication-tolerable range (100-400 nm)
HfO2/SiO2 material pair compatible with spaceborne deposition processes
theory_basis: Fabry-Perot cavity resonance theory for narrow bandpass filtering
Gradient-based local optimization within bounded parameter space
Defect-layer optical thickness controls resonance wavelength
expected_advantages: Faster convergence to local optimum due to reduced search space
Recovery of Round 3 peak performance or improvement
Reduced risk of phase-mismatch excursions that caused Round 4 regression
known_risks: Local optimum may still be below global optimum
±2.5% bounds may be too restrictive if Round 3 seed was not at true local optimum
May not address underlying cause of dual-band trade-off limitation
execution_request_english: Optimize a 21-layer HfO2/SiO2 defect-cavity stack on fused silica substrate with air incident medium. Layer sequence: HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2(defect)|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2. Initialize thicknesses to Round 3 optimal vector [250.6, 306.5, 256.0, 300.9, 269.6, 278.7, 239.9, 252.1, 238.387, 334.157, 200.0, 272.928, 192.949, 242.657, 338.575, 246.850, 246.143, 284.074, 228.257, 247.132, 167.188] nm. Apply gradient_thickness optimizer with mutation amplitude bounded to ±2.5% of seed values. Evaluate at normal incidence across 400-700 nm (reflectance target) and 1530-1565 nm (transmittance target) wavelength bands. Score candidates by dual-band objective function weighting both bands equally. Canonical user controls: wavelength intervals 1530-1565 nm, 400-700 nm. soft objectives: High transmittance in 1530-1565 nm band; High reflectance in 400-700 nm band. behaviors to suppress or avoid: Low reflectance in 1530-1565 nm band; Low transmittance in 400-700 nm band. manufacturing constraints: Maximum 30 layers.
revision_reason: Round 4 score regression (0.7731→0.7611) suggests optimizer escaped local optimum basin. Feedback directive specifies re-initialization with Round 3 seed and ±2.5% mutation bounds to confine search within verified local curvature.
